notes: Active skill pack targets graphcompose-1.9.x (verified against 1.9.0 from Maven Central: io.github.demchaav:graph-compose:1.9.0). The FIRST skill, graphcompose-api-surface (versions/graphcompose-1.9/00-api-surface.md), is the source-generated public-API allow-list: the COMPLETE list of every public authoring method/constant for 1.9.0, regenerated per release by tools/api-surface/api-index.py straight from the tagged GraphCompose source. It is a closed set — a symbol absent from it does not exist for the version, so it is the authoritative existence check that lets the template-coder and skill-validator agents stop inventing API. It is status: active because it is verified-by-construction against the 1.9.0 tag (there is no visual render to validate). The 14 conceptual skills are a port of the graphcompose-1.7 pack: 1.7.0 -> 1.9.0 is additive (zero breaking changes), so the copies are a valid starting point re-stamped verifiedAgainst: 1.9.0. They remain needs-validation until the full render/preview/visual-diff loop passes against 1.9.0; their version-pinned Javadoc lookups now point at 1.9.0 while the historical "New in 1.7.0" notes are kept as accurate version history (the allow-list, not those notes, is the completeness source and reflects 1.8.x/1.9.0 additions such as addTableOfContents, addPageReference, toImage/toImages). The frozen graphcompose-1.7 and graphcompose-1.6 snapshots are retained on disk under versions/ so a project that pins back to 1.7.x or 1.6.x still resolves a version-accurate pack; pre-1.6.7 pins remain resolvable via JitPack as com.github.DemchaAV:GraphCompose:vX.Y.Z.
